\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}

\begin{document}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:zero-add}
For every natural number $n$, one has $0+n=n$.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
This is the left-zero law for addition.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:add-zero}
For every natural number $n$, one has $n+0=n$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Apply induction and compare with Lemma~\ref{lem:zero-add}.
\end{proof}

\end{document}
